name: Shinma Kourin
source:
The world of conflict between light and darkness.

A young man gained the divine power of the darkness and is pursued by light forces. His aim is to dominate the temple of four lights in a year's time. Following the maid, with the power of the gods of darkness he needs to eat corpses of light and absorb the girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个光明与黑暗彼此争斗的世界。

一名青年获得了黑暗神力，也因此遭到光明势力追杀。他的目标是在一年内支配“四光神殿”。在女仆的陪伴下，他必须运用黑暗诸神的力量吞噬光明一方的尸体，并吸收那些少女。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
